summary: The vehicle's single shift window; the whole route (incl. service + waiting) must fit within it.
range: A single [start, end] pair of Unix seconds (singular — unlike task time_windows which is a 2-D array). start <= end.
businessRules: Route end (last arrival + service) must be <= time_window[1].
Waiting for a late task window counts toward elapsed shift time.

time_window defines: time_window field is used to describe the time period during which a vehicle is available to perform assigned tasks. The time\_window should be specified in the format of \[start\_timestamp,end\_ti…
Each element in time_window must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Must stay consistent with: jobs.time_windows, vehicles.max_working_time. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Shipments: pickup always occurs before delivery on the route.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
validationRules: A 2-D array (task-style) here -> 400 (vehicle uses a single pair).
testingGuidance: Positive: shift [32400,61200] (09:00–17:00) comfortably fits the route.
Positive: feasible route inside a tight shift, e.g. [32400,36000] with one nearby job.
Boundary: route ending exactly at time_window[1] accepted.
Negative-infeasible: a job forcing route end past time_window[1] -> unassigned (couples with max-duration-distance-cap).
Interaction: a long wait for a late task window pushes route end past the shift -> unassigned.
Interaction: Infeasible: nearest task's leg alone exceeds max_travel_time -> vehicle serves nothing.
Interaction: Interaction: a 40-min wait for a late window pushes route end past the shift -> unassigned.
Interaction: Break duration: vehicle with max_working_time 480 and two 30-min breaks + 8h driving -> working time 480 (hits cap, no room for service).
Interaction: Layover: max_working_time 480, 120-min layover + 360-min driving -> working time exactly 480.
Interaction: Infeasible: job window [09:00,09:30], max_visit_lateness 0, nearest vehicle arrives 09:45 -> unassigned.
Interaction: Interaction: a long wait for a late window pushes route end past the shift -> unassigned (couples with max-duration-distance-cap).
Interaction: Shipment: delivery window [09:00,09:30], max_visit_lateness 15, nearest vehicle arrives 09:40 -> accepted within lateness.
Interaction: Break: break time_windows [12:00,13:00], vehicle arrives 12:30 -> break scheduled at 12:30.
